name: Gearbox
text: Switch to the NVIDIA H100 with the Llama 3.4 70B model. This combination optimizes processing power and model performance, which can enhance EXCAVA's capabilities significantly. The trade-off is the potential cost increase associated with upgrading hardware and model access. However, the improved efficiency justifies this investment, driving better results.

name: Torque
text: H100’s cost and integration risk outweigh the gains—EXCAVA’s bottleneck isn’t raw compute, it’s data quality and model alignment. Fine-tuned Llama 3.3 70B risks overfitting to narrow data, masking the real bottleneck; test a smaller, open model like Qwen3-30B first to verify if the upgrade moves the needle at all.
